name: Magic Kyun! Renaissance
original_name: マジきゅんっ！ルネッサンス
source:
A cross media collaboration project between Sunrise & Broccolli.

In a world where art becomes magic, Aigasaki Kohana is a student who just enrolled into Hoshigei Academy, a high school conceived to help students fully develop their art. Inspired by her late mother, a flower arranger, she enrolls as a second year student. However, while she discovers what becoming an Artista really means, she'll discover friendship and love...
translation:
Sunrise與Broccoli跨媒體合作企劃。

在藝術能夠化為魔法的世界，愛咲小花剛轉進私立星之森魔法藝術高中。這所高中旨在幫助學生充分發展藝術才能。受花藝師亡母的影響，她以二年級學生身分入學。然而，在逐漸明白成為魔法藝術家（Artista）的意義的同時，她也會發現友情與愛情……
